comparison.objective: Release a spot-welder lid and tip its battery into a box; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a tool, press a latch, and pour out a tight-fitting cell versus countertorque adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Lid open, cell boxed, welder returned versus accurate locked angle and repeated motion.
comparison.reason: Latch release and battery removal are different from stop-screw locking.
